headline: Deliver Anything.
subtitle: Connect your business with independent couriers in your area.
createText: Add pickup, an approximate destination area, and a cash amount.
chooseText: Independent couriers browse and choose the opportunities they want.
completeText: Track status, chat securely, and exchange cash outside the platform.
responsibility: OpenDelivery provides technology for connecting businesses with independent courier service providers. Delivery arrangements and cash payments are made directly between participating parties.
noPayments: OpenDelivery does not collect, hold, split, or transfer delivery money.
